headline: Casualties Spike Across Fronts as Bases Turn
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the heaviest fighting remains on the Nevish Line, where two‑hour losses still exceed fourteen hundred Colonial and two thousand Warden dead though the one‑hour trend shows a cooling, while the two‑hour trend accelerates. Linn Mercy has quieted sharply, its latest two‑hour toll falling to fifty‑four Colonial and fifty‑nine Warden casualties after a previous surge. Weathered Expanse has awakened, adding five hundred thirty Colonial and four hundred fifty‑four Warden dead in the past two hours and logging thirty‑nine base changes over the day. Callahans Passage continues its grinding pace with thirteen hundred twenty‑four Colonial and eight hundred three Warden losses and nineteen ownership shifts in twenty‑four hours. Mooring County’s casualties have risen to two thousand four hundred seventy‑eight Colonial and two thousand two hundred sixty‑seven Warden in the last two hours, with sixteen daily events. Marban Hollow remains modest, recording fourteen Colonial and forty‑seven Warden dead and eleven base turnovers. Enlistments are climbing across all active sectors, feeding fresh manpower into the contested fronts.
